budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg is firm on a $2000 per connection charge, so the new connection fee would be $2000.

budget_items.topic: Fitchburg sewer rate and the $1.65 delta
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Fitchburg's rate to the town is $5.80; Fitchburg charges its residents $4.15, leaving a $1.65 difference that has always been penny for penny.
budget_items.quote: fitchburg's current rate is $5.80 to us. they charge their residents $4.15 and there has always been that $1.65 delta.

budget_items.topic: Negotiating the overall rate for taking over Tri-Town billing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Steve P. suggested the overall rate of 5.80 might be reduced in negotiation if the town takes over billing; no benefit to the town was found.
budget_items.quote: steve p. thought maybe we could reduce our overall rate of 5.80 in negotiation for taking it

budget_items.topic: Fitchburg flow and capacity figures (CWMP Table 2-7)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Table 2-7 buildout figure was 258,500 and is now 251,800; current flow is 104,000 gpd with a 25% contingency of 130,000.

budget_items.topic: John Fitch Highway improvement cost share
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town would pay a percentage of the John Fitch Highway improvement cost, based on its flow share, as a one-time expense spread over 20 years; cost not yet known.
budget_items.quote: we will be charged the percentage of what their flow is to ours when the improvement cost is known, one time expense, to be spread over 20 years.
